description: Sistema SCA - Sistema de Controle de Água e Esgoto is a dataset listed in City of Porto Alegre open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Departamento Municipal de Água e Esgotos. Sistema eletrônico comercial do DMAE, onde estão os registros dos dados relativos aos ramais de água e de esgotos (cloacal e misto). Coverage: Porto Alegre. The portal files it under the publisher Departamento Municipal de Água e Esgotos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-poa-portal.
